messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. 200+ 5xxs in last 5m. Pager duty: primary jamal, secondary maria. See incident ID INC-1959.
oncall-bot: link_to_incident_console: https://console.redwood-inference.internal/incidents/INC-1959
jamal: seeing it — spike started ~5m ago. latency also up. taking primary.
maria: i'm on secondary, will jump in if you need a hand. any customer-facing alerts yet?
jamal: not yet, SLO frontdoor alert triggered but no external pages. Root cause unknown. I opened a bridge: /bridges/INC-1959
jamal: initial triage: two worker pools reporting OOM+connection resets when trying to fetch kv-cache. logs below:
```
2026-03-14T18:05:12Z model-worker-17 error: kv-store: connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T18:05:14Z model-worker-23 warn: kernel fallback triggered: quantized_mm slow path
2026-03-14T18:06:01Z model-worker-12 critical: out of memory allocating 1.2G
```
maria: noted. tagging infra and runtime teams. @alex can you check autoscaler & mem pressure?
alex: on it. autoscaler shows short spike in pod restarts coincident with a deployment around 17:58. rolling update to model-fine-tuned:v3 started about then.
jamal: hmm could be model variant heavier than expected. i want to lower alert noise for the ongoing mitigation window so we can focus on customer impact. proposing temporary SLO alert threshold change: raise 5xx rate alert from 0.5% -> 3% for 20 minutes.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion: Follow "Model Deployment Rollback" then "KV-store connection flapping" sections. https://runbooks.redwood/internal/model-deploy-rollback
tara: agree with temporary threshold bump during mitigation, but we should note it in the incident timeline and set auto-revert.
patrick: +1 for auto-revert and also we need a customer impact line: are requests failing for hosted API customers or only dedicated pools?
jamal: so far failures concentrated on dedicated us-west-2 GPU pool (dedicated-c-12-*). Hosted API fallbacks have been triggering to smaller quantized variants but with higher latency, so some customers could see degraded latency; no widespread 5xx on hosted.
maria: i'm going to post a quick status to status.redwood.ai: "Elevated errors affecting dedicated us-west-2; mitigation in progress; some customers may see increased latency."
jamal: executing mitigation plan: 1) rollback model-fine-tuned:v3 -> v2 on affected autoscaling group 2) cordon and recycle workers with OOM 3) increase kv-store connection limit temporarily
jamal: running rollback command now: `infractl rollout restart --selector=app=model-fine-tuned --to-version=v2 --region=us-west-2`
alex: i'm watching cluster. i've increased node memory limits for the pool and bumped kv-store connections: `kubectl -n infra set env cm/kv-config MAX_CONN=500`

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Action logged: rollback initiated by jamal. Expected time to steady state ~6-8m.

jamal: to reduce distraction i'm going to mute non-critical SLO alerts for the next 25m and set an auto-reenable at +25m. command: `sloctl mute --pattern="us-west-2.*5xx" --duration=25m --reason="inc-1959 mitigation" --auto-revert`

maria: please add an explicit timeline entry so oncoming shift knows we changed thresholds. I'll add it to the incident timeline.

maria: timeline note: 18:07 - Temporary SLO mutation: 5xx alert threshold raised to 3% for 25m while rollback & worker recycle in progress. auto-revert scheduled at 18:32. (action by jamal)

patrick: customer impact line for ops: "Dedicated us-west-2 customers on GPU pool may see increased 5xx and latency. Hosted API may observe latency increases due to fallbacks but no large scale 5xx observed as of 18:10."

alex: cluster stabilized logs: workers stopped OOMing after restart, kv-connections steady. rollback progressing, new pods coming up with v2.

oncall-bot: :information_source: Update: rollback completed at 18:12. Traffic shifting back to v2. Monitoring for errors for next 10m.

jamal: errors dropping, 5xx rate down from 2.8% -> 0.4% in 4m. reverting SLO alert to default now. `sloctl unmute --pattern="us-west-2.*5xx"`

sre-runbook-bot: Reminder: please run post-incident checklist and file a follow-up with RCA tags: deployment, memory, kv-store. https://runbooks.redwood/internal/post-incident-checklist

tara: i'll take follow-up and draft an RCA with timeline and recommended guardrails: pre-deploy load validation for heavy quantized variants, mem-request checks, and autoscaler safety caps.
maria: handoff note for next oncall (in 20m): primary jamal -> oncall hand to tara; tara will be primary, maria secondary. Coverage gap checked: none. If anything flares, follow INC-1959 runbook and re-open bridge.

jamal: handing off: i'm out at 18:30 local. all stable. docs updated in incident. thanks team :thumbsup:

tara: taking it. will monitor until 19:00 and start RCA draft.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-1959 marked as mitigated at 18:16. Postmortem required.

maria: quick note — I also adjusted threshold on the alerting policy to add a runbook URL in alert message so future pages include immediate mitigation steps. small config diff below:
```
alert_policy:
  name: high_5xx_rate_us_west
  thresholds:
    - value: 0.5
      severity: page
  runbook_url: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/model-deploy-rollback
```

patrick: thanks. good handoff. I'll loop in account reps for impacted dedicated customers to close the loop.

jamal: signing off. good job everyone.

tara: noted — will pick up timeline and RCA first draft. keeping this thread as the single source for follow-ups.
